title: Trigger Finger and Common Finger Tendon Injuries
qa: Why must a mallet finger splint never be removed with the tip unsupported? Any bending can disrupt healing and restart the timeline.
Which test isolates FDP? Holding the PIP straight while the patient flexes the DIP.
Why is jersey finger urgent? The tendon can retract; delay makes repair difficult.
Which condition gives a flexed PIP and hyperextended DIP? Boutonniere deformity.
After flexor tendon repair, what is forbidden early? Resisted flexion and passive finger extension with the wrist extended.
